The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

You maintain control, and your data stays with you. This structure bypasses the common pitfalls associated with payment gateways while providing a seamless experience for you and your customers.

Getting Your First Transaction Live

Share the benefits of your offerings and how customers can access them seamlessly. Encourage early customers with incentives, such as discounts or exclusive access to new products. Once you receive your first payment, monitor the transaction closely to ensure that everything functions correctly. This first transaction is pivotal, validating your setup and providing confidence in the infrastructure you’ve built. Celebrate this milestone, as it marks the beginning of your journey towards sustainable international revenue.
